newsitem.title: UK: Feb Brent programme 38 cargoes, 1.36 mln bls topup.
newsitem.headline: Feb Brent programme 38 cargoes, 1.36 mln bls topup.

text.p: The February North Sea Brent Blend crude oil loading programme has been set at the equivalent of 38 cargoes of 500,000 barrels and 1.36 million barrels in smaller top-up cargoes, traders said.
The February programme was down from the original January programme of 44 500,000-barrels standard cargoes and 1.509 million barrels in topups.
But traders said the lower programme was due to the fact that there are three fewer days in February.
Traders said daily production at the Brent and Ninian systems, which combine to make up world benchmark Brent Blend, was expected to remain around January levels.
